remarks: This spacious one bedroom pied-a-terre is in the heart of the Glenville area in Greenwich, CT. This corner unit is bright, private & quiet.Enjoy the open floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining and the living room with a fireplace. Relax on the private terrace overlooking a wooded area. The large bedroom has a walk-in closet plus an additional closet. The bathroom with tub is large and there is a Washer/Dryer in the apartment. Lots of closets plus a large storage room. One assigned parking space. NO PETS ALLOWED. *Please note - there are exterior stairs down to the apartment entrance. Kitchen countertops to be replaced.* The Hawthorne is in central Glenville, close to shops, restaurants, community center, park & schools. Minutes to downtown Greenwich, Port Chester & MetroNorth stations. Easy access to Merrit Pky/Hutch. A fantastic value.
